name: Typewise
long_description:
Typewise resolves customer service requests end-to-end. Someone sends a request; it reads the message, looks up the real order or account in your own systems, takes the action, and replies. Anything it shouldn't touch goes to a human. It works across email, chat, WhatsApp and social, and is MCP-native.

Until now, that took a proper setup project, which is why it was mostly larger companies using it. Nova does the setup for you. You describe how you want things handled, in plain sentences:
- "Handle refunds under €50 yourself."
- "Anything about enterprise pricing goes to a human."
- "Turn bug reports into Linear issues and assign them to the Excellence team."

Nova connects the tools, configures the agents, tests them against your past conversations, and shows you what it got wrong before anything goes live. Nothing ships without your approval. First deployment takes 15 minutes. After that, it keeps going: it surfaces what customers keep complaining about, proposes fixes, and ships the ones you approve. We call it an AI Operator because it doesn't just answer customers; it keeps the entire operation working and improving. Across live accounts, that means 90% of requests resolved without human involvement.

Your team stays in control of what it may do on its own. Hybrid intelligence handles partial hand-offs, review-before-send, and context-preserving resumption.

We're YC S22 and work with companies like Superhuman and Unilever. Fortune 500 brands such as Unilever and DPD use Typewise to cut support effort by 50%+ while increasing CSAT and NPS. Run it natively in Typewise Ticketing or inside Zendesk, Salesforce or Freshdesk, with a CRM-embedded copilot for your human agents. EU-hosted, ISO 27001 certified.

launches.title: Typewise Nova: The customer operator for fast-growing teams
launches.tagline: Customer service that runs itself, so you can keep building.
launches.body:
At YC, we move fast. But staying on top of customer requests can quickly turn into a second job, and it takes time away from building and growing.

We're **Typewise (S22)** and we built Nova to remove that tradeoff. Typewise resolves customer requests end-to-end. Nova is the AI operator that sets up, runs, and improves that system for you. Your first deployment takes about 15 minutes.

Tell Nova how you want customer requests handled, in plain language:

* "Handle refunds under $50 automatically."
* "Send enterprise-pricing questions to Sales."
* "Create a Linear issue for every bug report and assign it to Engineering."

Nova connects the relevant tools, configures the agents and workflows, and tests them against your past conversations. It shows you what it got wrong before anything goes live. Nothing ships without your approval.

Once live, Typewise handles requests 24/7. It understands the message, looks up the information in your systems, takes approved actions, and replies. Anything outside the boundaries you've set goes to a human.

Nova keeps improving the system. It spots recurring questions, complaints, and cases Typewise couldn't resolve, then proposes changes to the knowledge and workflows. You approve the changes before they go live.

**See it in action, in hi-fi:**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7XXOm19aUCQ>

**Or in lo-fi:**

<https://youtu.be/ojOL0Ux3Sx8>

### Our launch gift

We strongly believe the product should do the talking, so **your first 1,000 resolutions or your first 3 months are on us**, whichever comes first.

Give it a try!

Janis & David

[**Typewise**](https://typewise.app/) **is a powerful AI writing solution for customer service and sales teams.**

Typewise helps customer service and sales teams to:

* Increase writing efficiency by >20%
* Eliminate >97% of mistakes
* Ensure brand coherence & tone of voice
* Improve customer satisfaction (CSAT, etc.) & sales conversion
* Save >8 hours per employee per month
* Get 3-4X ROI

Our AI text prediction technology outperforms Google & Co and was initially developed through our smartphone app with >2 million downloads.

We already work with Fortune 500 companies (software, e-commerce, logistics, insurance, telco).

**What can Typewise do?**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64168&key=user_uploads/737174/1a0256c1-10b5-4def-a67d-40ac30271153)

* Sentence prediction (autocomplete) and smart snippets
* Proofreader (autocorrect and grammar check)
* Auto replies
* Real-time translation
* Analytics & quality control

Our AI language model gets trained on your company’s data to ensure consistent, on-brand communications across your business. We also incorporate your business metrics (CSAT, etc.) to surface what type of wording, phrases, etc. leads to better business outcomes, and suggest the most effective language automatically.

**How does Typewise work?**

💻 Browser extension + server-side API\
✅ Works with any CRM (e.g., Salesforce)\
🌐 Support for 40+ languages\
👍 No IT implementation effort / <8h setup time\
🔒 100% data privacy
